title: Free Online Course in Employee Stress and Well-being Management
description: The Professional Certificate in Employee Stress and Well-being Management aims to equip the learner with the fundamental concept and realities of employee stress and methods to overcome the challenge of stress at work.
longDescription: Understand stress and the causes of stress in the workplace Investigate the consequences of stress on performance Critically assess methods of reducing stress levels in an organization The Professional Certificate in Employee Stress and Well-being Management aims to equip the learner with the fundamental concept and realities of employee stress and methods to overcome the challenge of stress at work.
